mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth declines by > 2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 6% and real retail sales rise by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 6% and RSAFS y/y growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month and payroll employment declines, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp m/m and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year and industrial production growth slows to below 1% year-over-year, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST y/y growth < -10% and INDPRO y/y growth < 1%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth < -10% and INDPRO y/y growth < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and the consumer price index rises by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals a tightening monetary cycle with rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL y/y growth > 3%.
